name: M51
notes: Face-on grand-design + NGC 5195 companion. The showpiece. High SB core, fainter arms — the more subs the better the bridge.

name: M63
notes: Flocculent spiral, mottled arms. Rewards integration time.

name: NGC5907
notes: Ultra-thin edge-on, faint stellar tidal stream loops around it (needs a dark site). Disk itself is high-SB.

name: M94
notes: Compact bright core + faint outer ring. High inner SB — core is easy, outer ring needs depth.

name: NGC4631
notes: Warped edge-on 'whale' + dwarf companion NGC 4627. Frames with the Hockey Stick (NGC 4656).

name: M102
notes: Edge-on lenticular with sharp dust lane. Small but high SB — tiny on the S30's wide field.

name: M64
notes: Bright spiral with a dramatic dark dust cap over the core. High SB — the dust lane shows quickly.

name: NGC4565
notes: The definitive edge-on: knife-thin disk, central bulge, dust lane. High SB — superb from the city.

name: M106
notes: Bright Seyfert spiral with anomalous arms. Bright core, easy from JC.

name: M101
notes: Big, beautiful, LOW surface brightness face-on. Bright mag is deceptive — hard from the city, wants a dark site.

name: NGC6503
notes: Isolated near-edge-on at the edge of the Local Void. High dec — well placed in summer.

name: NGC4490
notes: Interacting starburst with companion NGC 4485. Distorted, blue.

name: NGC6946
notes: Face-on, prolific supernova factory. Low SB face-on + sits in the Milky Way (star-dense) — better from a dark site, but high all summer.

name: M108
notes: Edge-on with mottled dust. Pairs in-frame with the Owl Nebula (M97) on a wide field.

name: NGC4656
notes: Hooked, tidally distorted edge-on. Lowish SB; pairs with the Whale in one wide frame.

name: M109
notes: Barred spiral just off Phecda (γ UMa) — watch the bright star's glare.

name: M82
notes: Edge-on starburst, very high SB — excellent from the city. Red Ha plume shows even in OSC LP.

name: M87
notes: Giant elliptical, the Virgo Cluster's heart. Bright; the famous jet needs aperture, but it anchors a Markarian's Chain wide field.

name: M86
notes: Lenticular, Markarian's Chain. Center the Chain, not the single galaxy.

name: M60
notes: Elliptical; pairs with spiral NGC 4647 in-frame.

name: M90
notes: Large Virgo spiral, blueshifted. Dust detail with depth.

name: M85
notes: Lenticular at the north end of the Virgo Cluster. Bright, smooth.

name: M81
notes: Grand-design spiral, bright core. Circumpolar from JC — usable most of the year. Frames with M82.

name: M98
notes: Near-edge-on spiral, blueshifted (approaching). Lowish SB.

name: M88
notes: Multi-arm spiral, one of the brighter Virgo Cluster members.

name: M84
notes: West end of Markarian's Chain. The S30's wide field can frame the whole Chain (M84/M86/NGC 4438...) — a signature OSC-scout shot.

name: M49
notes: Brightest Virgo Cluster galaxy (giant elliptical). Bright but smooth.

name: M100
notes: Grand-design face-on, one of the largest Virgo Cluster spirals.

name: M99
notes: Face-on one-armed spiral. Small on the S30.
